correctness.rationale: A three-step return forces a common firing count q=0,1,2,3; only q=1 or2 can be primitive. Necessary-and-sufficient phase intervals imply all three colors on each shore and give every term of the multinomial polynomial. Chip complement rigorously pairs q=1 and q=2; the dot-product lower bound and common interval top establish full support; disjoint-excess counting proves the outer endpoint. Explicit direct-state and separate phase-enumeration finite tests corroborate the derivation but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Chip mass is a natural conserved parameter. Unlike existing period-existence results, the two-shore polynomial classifies every initial primitive-three state by energy, proves a sharp fully populated exterior spectrum with a macroscopic missing middle band, and gives two distinct endpoint census formulas. The m,n>=4 overlap statistic and lower-boundary multiplicity add genuine structure beyond the m=3 special case.
